config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
set fabric-object enable
set passive-fqdn-learning enable
set cache-ttl 600
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.0_24"
set subnet 10.0.0.0 255.255.255.0
set fabric-object enable
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.0.1-172.16.0.9"
set type iprange
set start-ip 172.16.0.1
set end-ip 172.16.0.9
set fabric-object enable
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-example.com-Grp"
set type folder
set category default
set comment "Generated at 2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
set color 7
set fabric-object enable
set member "Prefix-example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.0_24-Grp"
set type folder
set category default
set comment "Generated at 2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
set color 7
set fabric-object enable
set member "Prefix-10.0.0.0_24"
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.0.1-172.16.0.9-Grp"
set type folder
set category default
set comment "Generated at 2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
set color 7
set fabric-object enable
set member "Prefix-172.16.0.1-172.16.0.9"
next

edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set type folder
set category default
set comment "Generated at 2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
set color 7
set fabric-object enable
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-10.0.0.0_24" "Prefix-172.16.0.1-172.16.0.9"
next

end
